annotations.title: How capital reaches this institution, and where it goes next

description: Capital flow paths through one institution: plan to fund to manager to company, sponsor to borrower to facility to lender, and more. Each hop names its graph, id, role and basis, with the amount where disclosed and a rule-graded confidence. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer states what it withheld.

dfx_id.description: A DFX id of the form dfx:<graph>:<id> (fo, isi, vc, pe, ria, al, pc, ref), or a bare real estate id.

include_former.description: Also return paths through a lender edge no longer held, marked FORMER.

kind.description: One path kind as the summary names it (for example ALLOCATOR_TO_PE_FUND_TO_MANAGER).
